chunks: Abu Muhammad Ja'far ibn Nu'aym al-Hakim al-Shathani - may God have Mercy upon him - narrated that Ahmad ibn Idris quoted on the authority of Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Obayd, on the authority of Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha', who said:

Ar-Ridha' (peace be upon him) told him, 'When they wanted to take me out of Medina, I gathered my family and ordered them to cry over me so that I would hear it. Then I distributed among them twelve thousand Dinars, and I said, 'Indeed, I will never return to my family again.''

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Ar-Ridha (a title for Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ar-Ridha do with his family and wealth before leaving Medina?
ai.summary: Imam Ar-Ridha (a.s.) gathered his family and instructed them to weep so he could hear their grief, then distributed twelve thousand Dinars, declaring he would not return, indicating his permanent departure (death). This event highlights the Imam's awareness of his impending death and his deliberate preparation of his family for the transition of leadership. The distribution of wealth and the emotional farewell underscore the practical and spiritual dimensions of his final days in Medina before moving to Baghdad.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 47-28 Abu Muhammad Ja’far ibn Nu’aym al-Hakim ash-Shathani - may God have Mercy upon him - narrated that Ahmad ibn Idris quoted on the authority of Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Obayd, on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Washsha’

that Ar-Ridha’ (a.s.) told him, “When they wanted to take me out of Medina, I asked all my family members to gather around me and cry so that I would hear it. Then I divided up their inheritance share of twelve-thousand Dinars and told them, ‘I will never return to my family again.’”
